sources.title: NoRD: A Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model that Drives without ...
sources.snippet: Model Architecture NORD operates directly on raw sensor data and kinematic states to directly predict future trajectories, without intermediate language reasoning traces. The inputs include multi-view RGB images (front, front-left, front-right), past trajectory tokens, current speed, and acceleration.
